facts.fact: Ulshära 开门分兵：wards 认血——「If I fall, do not hesitate. Do what you must.」——西门 Angelica/Cosima、东门 Ulshära+Dante、北门 Risha 已拦。
西门火墙：Angelica 奏 Common Conquest 咏叹调放火墙——Rorik 弹指开光盾拱门让军团通行——「Huh! Very nice! Powerful! I like it!」——Cosima 报「your best friend is here. And—shit, is that Feathers?」

东门攻心：Dante 影线意图网+Nox 偷换 lightsbane Device——Ulshära 攻心「You think he will reward you...you are nothing but a sacrifice! He is sending you to Vitae to die!」——「And you should have been dead long before now.」——「somehow I think I understand the Sunslayer's intentions now.」
facts.anchor: He is sending you to Vitae to die!

facts.fact: 强制反噬：Dante 的「Die」因犹豫未成——「Because of his hesitance, the compulsion didn’t take. It backfired.」——鼻血跪地——「The rat got caught in its own trap.」
Taesia 现身：血符 earth 暗柱破场——「Seems I didn't get an invitation to this little get-together.」——对 Ulshära「You, on the other hand, have my undivided attention.」
facts.anchor: Seems I didn’t get an invitation

facts.fact: 兄妹重逢：「Not even a hello first? Nice horns.」「You little shit.」——「The ost Vonlins first...Don't subject Bee to that. Not again.」「You may as well earn that title.」
西门破与失控报：「a crash resounded across the plaza...as the western gates were breached」——Rian 后来传信「We couldn’t stop him, it was like… as the western gates were breached.」——Dante 闻西面破防
facts.anchor: as the western gates were breached.

facts.fact: 章末判词：「This was what it looked like to not be afraid of power or its costs.」——Taesia 的影分身战 Faün——Angelica 的嫉妒式敬语。
facts.anchor: to not be afraid of power or its costs.
